source_evidence: Player exact 'Elara, you should represent our houses in my absence in Caereth... as I will be absent often..,' authorizes standing political representation of V/House Vaishnavi in Caereth when absent, not unilateral commitment of either other house. Elara independently and gladly accepts, retains her own House Rethwyn authority, can advocate shared interests, attend eligible political meetings, maintain relationships and relay significant developments, with prior consent-based alliance limits preserved. Explicit V consent necessary to bind Vaishnavi to new military/financial/treaty/property obligations; Severin's separate representation awaits his explicit consent, no automatic three-house legal recognition or office. Councillor acknowledges designation for routine contacts and invitations without granting voting rights, diplomatic immunity or broader authority. No roll, expense or consequential time advance beyond conversation. D315~12:05 Caereth palace private council chamber. V has expressly delegated to willing Elara standing political representation of House Vaishnavi's interests in Caereth during his absences, alongside her independent authority over House Rethwyn. She may speak, attend eligible consultations, maintain political contacts, advocate agreed interests, and report developments; no authority to bind V to new financial, military, treaty or property commitments without his express consent. Representation of Severin or all three collectively awaits Severin's explicit assent and lawful alliance recognition as applicable; no automatic office, vote, Crown recognition or third-house mandate. Elara accepts willingly and councillor acknowledges designation for correspondence/invitations within his remit; no formal alliance enacted. D316 afternoon defense consultation invitation remains available to both. Crown frontier intelligence commission active, advance200gp received once, remaining300+1300 contingent; written credentials V-held. Kestrel copying in progress, original custody unchanged; guild Defense investigation late afternoon D315 planned. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi5/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Fenar59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 inactive; Cirren51/51 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots; Mara/Elara/horses healthy. Rest5/6 food21/feed28 purse403gp4sp6cp conditional240gp sale unpaid; evidence and other custody unchanged. Dice delegated until stop. Await V next action.
